description: Extract inline text from a message attachment (text/* and text/csv). PDF and other binary types are not extracted yet and return an `error` with a next step. Read-only; requires the `attachments` capability.

blob_id.description: Attachment blob id (from message attachments meta).

email_id.description: JMAP email id the attachment belongs to.

inbox_id.description: Inbox (mailbox) id. Must be in scope for the token.

name: mailbuttons_get_attachment_text

error.description: Set when extraction is unsupported, e.g. "pdf_extraction_not_enabled".

text.description: Extracted text for text/* and text/csv attachments.

title: Extract attachment text
